facts.fact: StackAdapt was named to G2's 2026 Best Software Awards, placing 5th on the Best Canadian Software Companies list.
facts.quote: placing 5th on the [Best Canadian Software Companies](https://www.g2.com/best-software-companies/canada) list

facts.fact: StackAdapt placed 12th on G2's Best Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Products list in the 2026 Best Software Awards.
facts.quote: 12th on the [Best Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Products](https://www.g2.com/best-software-companies/top-marketing) list

facts.fact: StackAdapt placed 72nd on G2's Best Global Software Companies list in the 2026 Best Software Awards.
According to StackAdapt's press release, StackAdapt is the top demand-side platform (DSP) as rated by G2 and the only DSP named to the Best Global Software Companies list.
facts.quote: StackAdapt is the [top demand-side platform (DSP)](https://www.g2.com/categories/demand-side-platform-dsp) as rated by G2 and the only DSP named to the Best Global Software Companies list.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states it has been recognized by G2 for the seventh year in a row.
facts.quote: Being recognized by G2 for the seventh year in a row is a testament to our team's relentless focus on building technology that delivers real value for our customers.

facts.fact: To be eligible for G2's 2026 Best Software Awards, a software company or product must have received at least 10 approved reviews during the 2025 calendar year.
facts.quote: a software company or product must have received at least 10 approved reviews during the 2025 calendar year.

facts.fact: G2 states more than 100 million people annually use G2 to make software decisions, including employees at all Fortune 500 companies.
facts.quote: More than 100 million people annually—including employees at all Fortune 500 companies—use G2 to make smarter software decisions

facts.fact: StackAdapt's unified platform covers CTV, DOOH, display, native, audio, email, and more, per the company's own description.
facts.quote: unifies programmatic and owned channels—including CTV, DOOH, display, native, audio, email, and more—into one seamless experience.
